title: Tables
sub: Abilities and skills as tables right on the sheet, a column formula, and armor class from dexterity.
start: on the sheet, the “Combat” block has “Hit points” and “Armor class”, there is a “Check die” and a “Strike” effect that takes 5 hit points off the target by itself. There are no tables yet.
formulaHint: The formula opens in the bar at the top of the screen. Do not type the whole name — start typing it and pick it from the suggestions. “done” or Enter saves.
kindsFirst: Above the sheet press “blocks and sheet types”.
opened: If the table is closed: in the “blocks and sheet types” view expand the block “{{name}}” and click “{{name}}” with the colon after it — the table opens above the sheet.

onSheet.title: A table on the sheet
onSheet.sum: The sheet has an “Abilities” table: strength and dexterity, the player enters “Value”, “Modifier” is calculated.

hero.title: The hero sheet
hero.sum: The abilities show on the sheet, armor class is calculated from dexterity, no errors.

skills.title: Skills
skills.sum: A “Skills” table: athletics has the ability “strength”, “Total” is the strength modifier plus “Value”.

alone.title: On your own
alone.sum: You added a column with a formula without hints.

block.lead: A table is like a spreadsheet: rows and columns. A hero's abilities are a table: the rows “strength” and “dexterity”, the columns “Value” and “Modifier”. Let us create it right on the sheet.
block.say: Create an “Abilities” block on the sheet.
block.name: Type the name “Abilities” and press Enter.
block.result: The “Abilities” block is on the sheet.

table.say: Create an “Abilities” table in the block.
table.name: The table opens above the sheet. Type its name “Abilities” and press Enter.
table.result: The “Abilities” table is in the block. The “Value” column is already there — the player enters it.

rows.first: In the empty row type “strength” and press Enter.
rows.second: In the new row type “dexterity” and press Enter.

modifier.lead: A column formula is calculated for each row separately: “Value” in it is the value of the same row — strength for strength, dexterity for dexterity.
modifier.name: Type the name “Modifier” and press Enter.
modifier.floor: Click “Formula for all rows” and type “floor((”.
modifier.value: Start typing “value” and pick “Value” in the list.
modifier.trap: There is an error in the formula: a bracket is not closed or there is an extra sign. It should come out as: floor((Value - 10) / 2).
modifier.result: The modifier is calculated in every row: for strength from the strength value, for dexterity from the dexterity value.

sample.say: Press “sheet sample”: strength and dexterity each have an input for “Value” and a calculated “Modifier”.
sample.result: The sheet sample is open: strength and dexterity show “Value” and “Modifier”.

armor.lead: A sheet field can take a number from any cell of a table — for example, the dexterity modifier.
armor.say: Make armor class grow with dexterity: 10 plus the dexterity modifier.
armor.ten: In the “Armor class” field click “Formula for all sheets” and type “10 + ”.
armor.pick: Start typing “modifier” and pick the “Modifier” of “dexterity” in the list.

problems.say: Press the “No problems” button in the header (if something is found, it says “Problems” and a number). There should be no errors.

skills.lead: A skill rests on an ability: athletics on strength. Let us make skills a table on the sheet too.
skills.say: Create a “Skills” block on the sheet with a “Skills” table and an “athletics” row.
skills.blockName: Type the name “Skills” and press Enter.
skills.tableName: Type the table name “Skills” and press Enter.
skills.row: In the empty row type “athletics” and press Enter.
skills.result: The “Skills” table is on the sheet, with the row “athletics”. The skill's “Value” is entered by the player — these are the points invested.

link.say: Add an “Ability” column to “Skills” that is chosen from the “Abilities” table.
link.plus: In the header of the “Skills” table press “+”.
link.name: Type the name “Ability” and press Enter.
link.trap: No table is set — there is nothing to choose from. In the “From table” field choose “Abilities”.

pick.say: In the “athletics” row, in the “Ability” column, choose “strength”.
pick.hint: You choose this as the rules author — for every hero athletics will come from strength.

through.lead: Through the “Ability” column a skill formula reaches a number in another table: for athletics, the strength modifier.
through.say: Add a “Total” column to “Skills”: the ability modifier plus “Value”.
through.name: Type the name “Total” and press Enter.
through.start: Click “Formula for all rows” and start typing “modifier”.
through.pick: In the list choose the “Modifier” of the “Ability” column.
through.result: For athletics “Total” is the strength modifier plus the invested points.

save.say: Add a “Save” column to the “Abilities” table, equal to the modifier.
save.goal: the “Abilities” table has a “Save” column that in every row equals the “Modifier” of the same row, and “Problems” shows no errors.
save.hint: Open the table: expand the “Abilities” block and click “Abilities” with the colon after it. Then “+” in its header, in the formula start typing “modifier” and pick “Modifier”.
save.trap: “Save” ended up as a separate sheet field, but it must be a column of the “Abilities” table. Delete the field and add a column with “+” in the table header.
